- Version updated to 0.2.0.
- Test identifier section reflects the new version and updated creation timestamp (2026-06-10T11:34:16+08:00).

Initial public release of the automated integration test skill for TOSR.

- Introduces automated testing of the skill lifecycle (publish, inspect, update, delete) via the clawhub REST API.
- Skill is ephemeral and self-deletes after test completion.
- Includes documentation for usage and test identification details.
